settings.ekit_heading_title: Nil T2 Filing in Ottawa for a Year With No Activity
settings.ekit_heading_extra_title:
A corporation does not have to be finished to have a nil year. Plenty of Ottawa companies work steadily, then spend a full tax year without invoicing anything at all, and pick up again afterwards. That middle year is still a filing year. It is filed as nil, separately from the years on either side of it.

Which is why the first thing we do is check the year rather than assume it. One invoice, one expense claimed or one movement through the bank account and the year is not nil, and we say so before charging for it. Where it does qualify, the return is prepared, reviewed by a CPA, signed with a T183CORP and transmitted. Nepean, Kanata or downtown, the work is the same and none of it is done in person.

settings.title: What the Fee Does Not Cover

settings.editor:
A nil T2 does not cover your Ontario annual return through the Ontario Business Registry. We tell you if you still owe one.

A federal Corporations Canada annual return costs $12.00 and is due within 60 days of your anniversary. It is a government fee and HST does not apply to it.

This service is for a corporation with no activity in the tax year. A corporation with investment income, rental income, or dividends paid or received is not nil. If your corporation is not nil, we move your file to gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 plus applicable sales tax per year and tell you before any further charge.

settings.title: File your Ottawa corporation’s quiet year
Nil Years in Ottawa: Questions We Get

settings.html:
The corporation traded last year but not this one. Does that still count?

Yes. The test is applied year by year, not to the corporation as a whole. A quiet year between two active ones is filed as nil on its own. What no activity means.

Can you file only the nil years and leave the rest to my own accountant?

Yes. We file the years that qualify and hand the others back untouched, so nothing is done twice and nothing is billed twice.

Where exactly is the line between nil and not nil?

Any revenue, any expense claimed, any payroll, any movement through the bank account puts a year on the other side of it. Investment income, rent and dividends do the same. When a year is not nil.

I invoiced once in the year, for a small amount. Is it still nil?

No. One invoice is revenue, so the year is a regular T2 rather than a nil filing. We tell you that before anything is charged.

What is the deadline when the year end is not December?

Six months after whatever your year end is. A March 31 year end is due September 30. Work out your date.

How is the return authorised?

With a T183CORP for that tax year, signed on screen. One year, one form. How signing works.

Several quiet years in a row. Are they priced any differently?

No. Each is its own return at $300.00 plus HST per tax year, filed oldest first. Catch-up filing.

Is my Ontario annual return handled at the same time?

No. That one goes to the Ontario Business Registry and sits outside this service, though we check whether it is outstanding. Check your date.

I am winding the corporation down after a quiet year. What is left to do?

A final T2 covering the period to dissolution, due six months after it. That is what closes the account. Final T2 before dissolution.

Do I have to be in Canada to sign?

No. The signature is electronic, so a director can authorise the return from anywhere. Non-resident owned corporations.
